summary: A dehydrated, improperly equipped climber far off-route on Capitol Peak called for rescue; on-foot teams and a reconnaissance flight failed to locate him before a Colorado National Guard Blackhawk helicopter spotted and evacuated him.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Colorado National Guard Blackhawk helicopter
notes: One of four MRA callouts in the Capitol valley Sept 3-5, 2022; date pinned to Sept 4 (Sunday) per the article sequence after the Sept-3 fatality (id 1145).
